1: import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
2: import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
3: 
4: const STREAK_COUNT_KEY = "streak_count";
5: const LAST_VISIT_KEY = "streak_last_visit";
6: const LONGEST_STREAK_KEY = "streak_longest";
7: const STREAK_TOAST_PENDING_KEY = "streak_toast_pending";
8: 
9: export const STREAK_TIERS = [3, 7, 14, 30, 100, 365];
10: 
11: interface StreakData {
12:   count: number;
13:   longest: number;
14:   isNewDay: boolean;
15:   currentTier: number;
16:   nextTier: number;
17:   tierProgress: number;
18: }
19: 
20: function getDateString(date: Date): string {
21:   return date.toISOString().split("T")[0];
22: }
23: 
24: function getCurrentTierIndex(days: number): number {
25:   for (let i = STREAK_TIERS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
26:     if (days >= STREAK_TIERS[i]) return i;
27:   }
28:   return -1;
29: }
30: 
31: export function useStreak(): StreakData & {
32:   checkStreak: () => Promise<boolean>;
33:   consumePendingToast: () => Promise<StreakData | null>;
34: } {
35:   const [streakData, setStreakData] = useState<StreakData>({
36:     count: 0,
37:     longest: 0,
38:     isNewDay: false,
39:     currentTier: 0,
40:     nextTier: STREAK_TIERS[0],
41:     tierProgress: 0,
42:   });
43: 
44:   const checkStreak = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
45:     const today = getDateString(new Date());
46:     const lastVisit = await AsyncStorage.getItem(LAST_VISIT_KEY);
47:     const prevCount = parseInt(await AsyncStorage.getItem(STREAK_COUNT_KEY) || "0", 10);
48:     const prevLongest = parseInt(await AsyncStorage.getItem(LONGEST_STREAK_KEY) || "0", 10);
49: 
50:     if (lastVisit === today) {
51:       const idx = getCurrentTierIndex(prevCount);
52:       const nextTierVal = idx >= STREAK_TIERS.length - 1 ? STREAK_TIERS[STREAK_TIERS.length - 1] : STREAK_TIERS[idx + 1];
53:       const tierProgressVal = nextTierVal > 0 ? prevCount / nextTierVal : 1;
54:       setStreakData({
55:         count: prevCount,
56:         longest: prevLongest,
57:         isNewDay: false,
58:         currentTier: idx >= 0 ? STREAK_TIERS[idx] : 0,
59:         nextTier: nextTierVal,
60:         tierProgress: tierProgressVal,
61:       });
62:       return false;
63:     }
64: 
65:     const yesterday = new Date();
66:     yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1);
67:     const yesterdayStr = getDateString(yesterday);
68: 
69:     let newCount: number;
70:     if (lastVisit === yesterdayStr) {
71:       newCount = prevCount + 1;
72:     } else {
73:       newCount = 1;
74:     }
75: 
76:     const newLongest = Math.max(prevLongest, newCount);
77:     const idx = getCurrentTierIndex(newCount);
78:     const nextTierVal = idx >= STREAK_TIERS.length - 1 ? STREAK_TIERS[STREAK_TIERS.length - 1] : STREAK_TIERS[idx + 1];
79:     const tierProgressVal = nextTierVal > 0 ? newCount / nextTierVal : 1;
80: 
81:     await AsyncStorage.multiSet([
82:       [STREAK_COUNT_KEY, newCount.toString()],
83:       [LAST_VISIT_KEY, today],
84:       [LONGEST_STREAK_KEY, newLongest.toString()],
85:       [STREAK_TOAST_PENDING_KEY, "true"],
86:     ]);
87: 
88:     setStreakData({
89:       count: newCount,
90:       longest: newLongest,
91:       isNewDay: true,
92:       currentTier: idx >= 0 ? STREAK_TIERS[idx] : 0,
93:       nextTier: nextTierVal,
94:       tierProgress: tierProgressVal,
95:     });
96: 
97:     return true;
98:   }, []);
99: 
100:   const consumePendingToast = useCallback(async (): Promise<StreakData | null> => {
101:     const pending = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STREAK_TOAST_PENDING_KEY);
102:     if (pending !== "true") return null;
103:     await AsyncStorage.removeItem(STREAK_TOAST_PENDING_KEY);
104:     return streakData;
105:   }, [streakData]);
106: 
107:   useEffect(() => {
108:     checkStreak();
109:   }, [checkStreak]);
110: 
111:   return { ...streakData, checkStreak, consumePendingToast };
112: }
113: 
114: export async function getStreakFromStorage(): Promise<{ count: number; longest: number }> {
115:   const count = parseInt(await AsyncStorage.getItem(STREAK_COUNT_KEY) || "0", 10);
116:   const longest = parseInt(await AsyncStorage.getItem(LONGEST_STREAK_KEY) || "0", 10);
117:   return { count, longest };
118: }

22:   colorScheme: "light",
23:   toggleTheme: () => {},
24:   ctaColor: DEFAULTS.ctaColor,
25:   setCtaColor: () => {},
26:   derivedColors: deriveColorsFromAccent(DEFAULTS.ctaColor, false),

31: }
32:

35: }
36: 
37: export default function ThemeProvider({ children }: ThemeProviderProps) {
38:   const systemScheme = useRNColorScheme();
39:   const [userScheme, setUserScheme] = useState<ThemeColorScheme | null>(null);
40:   const [ctaColor, setCtaColorState] = useState(DEFAULTS.ctaColor);
41: 
42:   useEffect(() => {
43:     AsyncStorage.multiGet([THEME_KEY, CTA_COLOR_KEY])
44:       .then(([schemeEntry, ctaEntry]) => {
45:         if (schemeEntry[1] === "light" || schemeEntry[1] === "dark") {
46:           setUserScheme(schemeEntry[1]);
47:         }
48:         if (ctaEntry[1]) {
49:           setCtaColorState(ctaEntry[1]);
50:         }
51:       })
52:       .catch(() => {});
53:   }, []);
54: 
55:   const colorScheme: ThemeColorScheme = userScheme ?? (systemScheme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light");
56: 
57:   useEffect(() => {
58:     if (userScheme !== null) {
59:       AsyncStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, userScheme).catch(() => {});
60:     }
61:   }, [userScheme]);
62: 
63:   const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
64:     setUserScheme((prev) => (prev === "light" ? "dark" : "light"));
65:   }, []);
66: 
67:   const setCtaColor = useCallback((color: string) => {
68:     setCtaColorState(color);
69:     AsyncStorage.setItem(CTA_COLOR_KEY, color).catch(() => {});
70:   }, []);
71: 
72:   const derivedColors = useMemo(
73:     () => deriveColorsFromAccent(ctaColor, colorScheme === "dark"),
74:     [ctaColor, colorScheme]
75:   );
76:

79:   }, [ctaColor]);
